text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Omelet rice with demi-glace sauce, carrots al ajillo… and shkmeruli!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It all looks delicious! But kinda fatty… None of this stuff's gonna do m'skin any favors…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My complexion'd be better off with stews and fish… I know that… I know that, but still!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! The city's just got sooo many tempt'n treats!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Yukino Bijin is worried about the condition of her skin.
